title: Patterns and reasoning
description: Notice a repeat, test a rule and separate a good guess from a conclusion that must follow. Five small lessons build a careful way to solve puzzles.
introduction:
Notice a repeat, test a rule and separate a good guess from a conclusion that must follow. Five small lessons build a careful way to solve puzzles.

Change the examples, check your predictions and take the short quiz at the end of each lesson. You can return to any chapter whenever you like.
prerequisites: Basic counting. No previous logic lessons needed.

lessons.objective: Find the repeating unit before predicting the next item.
Check a proposed number rule against every step.
Distinguish turning a shape from reflecting it.
Sort objects by two rules at once.
Identify what must follow from the stated facts.

outcomes: Find the repeating unit before predicting the next item.
Check a proposed number rule against every step.
Distinguish turning a shape from reflecting it.
Sort objects by two rules at once.
Identify what must follow from the stated facts.

glossary.definition: The smallest block repeated to make a pattern.
A flip across a mirror line.
The objects belonging to both groups.
A conclusion that follows from the facts and rules given.
